summary: Iteration 4 - dashboard page + Sign up CTA. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed (no regressions on /api/waitlist POST, /api/waitlist/count GET, /api/). Frontend: nav-cta-sign-up labelled 'Sign up' and routes to /dashboard; mobile-nav-cta in drawer also routes to /dashboard. /dashboard renders Dashboard component with ALL 34 required data-testids: dash-sidebar, dash-header-title='Dashboard', dash-streak, dash-notifications, theme-toggle, dash-avatar, dash-welcome ('Welcome to Mediq'), dash-courses-empty + dash-view-courses + dash-get-access CTAs, dash-available-plans, dash-plan-ug (MOST POPULAR chip verified) + dash-plan-ug-buy, dash-plan-pg + dash-plan-pg-buy, dash-subject-{anatomy,pharmacology,pathology,medicine} + matching -buy testids, dash-continue-learning + dash-continue-unlock, dash-flashcards-preview + dash-flashcards-unlock, sidebar nav (dash-nav-home active, dash-nav-courses/videos/flashcards/progress/settings), dash-sidebar-upgrade, dash-nav-logout -> '/'. Dark mode verified on /dashboard: body bg becomes rgb(5,8,20) (#050814), sidebar paper adapts to rgb(11,18,32) (no white leak); localStorage 'mediq-theme' stores 'dark'/'light' and persists across reload. Prior landing flows still work: flashcard-flip, mcq-option-c, billing-monthly, billing-yearly, pricing-pro-cta, pricing-free-cta, faq-trigger-0..5 present; hero-waitlist-email/submit end-to-end returns success pill (real MongoDB write). Zero console errors across flows.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.tsx is 604 lines - still under the 700-line guideline but approaching it. Consider extracting plan/subject card definitions and the Flashcards-preview locked overlay into their own components for maintainability if more sections are planned.

navItems beyond 'Dashboard' (Courses/Videos/Flashcards/Progress/Settings) have no onClick handler or href; clicking them does nothing. If that's intentional 'coming soon' state, add aria-disabled or a visual lock cue; otherwise wire up routes or disable.

dash-sidebar-upgrade and dash-continue-unlock use href='#plans' which works only when the user is already on /dashboard; href will break if this sidebar is ever reused on another route. Prefer RouterLink to '/dashboard#plans'.

Dashboard route is publicly exposed with no auth - acceptable per PRD, but note that 'Buy now' buttons are non-functional placeholders (no onClick / href). Clearly mark them disabled or wire up checkout to avoid user confusion.
Static strings 'MONDAY · DAY 14' and '14-day streak' are hard-coded - fine for marketing preview but should come from an API/context once real users arrive.
Sidebar 'Back to site' uses LogoutOutlinedIcon which semantically implies auth-logout; swap to ArrowBack or Home icon to avoid confusing users since there is no auth.

Prior recommendations from iter3 remain open: unique index on waitlist.email (actually added in server.py startup hook - good), rate-limit /api/waitlist/count, consider bucketed position to avoid leaking total signups.
seed_data_creation: Two new waitlist rows created during UI integration test (TEST_iter4_<ts>@example.com, TEST_iter4_<ts2>@example.com). Cumulative TEST_* rows can be purged via: db.waitlist.delete_many({email:{$regex:'^test_'}}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard lives at /dashboard, no auth. Sidebar visible only >=md breakpoint (display xs:none md:block). Mobile viewport (<=sm) hides sidebar - use larger viewport for sidebar visibility checks. Theme toggle: clicking [data-testid='theme-toggle'] flips mode, localStorage key 'mediq-theme' ('light'|'dark'), dark body = rgb(5,8,20). After clicking nav-cta-sign-up wait_for_url alone is not enough; also wait_for_selector('[data-testid="dash-sidebar"]') to let React finish rendering. Landing page primary-nav, hero-waitlist-*, final-waitlist-*, flashcard-flip, mcq-option-c, billing-monthly/yearly, pricing-pro-cta, pricing-free-cta, faq-trigger-0..5 all still functional. Note: pricing-team-cta does not exist (never did).
